title: Dataset for recognition of snail trails and hot spot failures in monocrystalline Si solar panels
mechanism: Public drone IR images of a 4-panel string with a known cell-level layout of hot spots and snail trails, plus weather readings.
evidence: R: 277 images, 336 x 256 JPG, Zenmuse XT, Cali; CC BY 4.0 (Mendeley page).
adaptation: Smoke test for the deliverable's hot-spot localiser; not a generalisation test (one string).
min_experiment: Run the max-median hot-spot rule on it and check hits against the published cell layout; CPU.
